title: Nonempty weakly etale schemes over algebraically closed fields admit sections
statement: Let $\Omega$ be an algebraically closed field [def-weil-algebraic-closure], let $Z$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], and let $q:Z\to\operatorname{Spec}\Omega$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum] be a weakly etale morphism [def-weil-weakly-etale-morphism]. If the underlying topological space of $Z$ is nonempty, then there exists a morphism $s:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to Z$ with $q\circ s=\mathrm{id}_{\operatorname{Spec}\Omega}$ (a section of $q$).
